data.name: Prerequisites
data.value: Select an adapter, confirm the physical ECU profile and stop the bridge and console.

data.name: InvalidChannel
data.value: Select a valid physical ISO 15765-4 OBD CAN address pair.

data.name: Running
data.value: J1979 physical read campaign in progress.

data.name: Partial
data.value: Campaign interrupted or time budget reached; check individual results.

data.name: MutationsNotTested
data.value: Mode 04, legacy Mode 05 and Mode 08 control execution not tested.

data.name: ExportFailed
data.value: Could not export the J1979 report.

data.name: EvapVinRequired
data.value: Enter the documented 17-character VIN of the vehicle to test.

data.name: EvapWarning
data.value: This operation requests the ECU to establish the conditions for an evaporative-system leak test; it does not itself perform the leak test. Follow the manufacturer's procedure, ensure the vehicle is stationary, engine stopped, in a ventilated area and safe to test. The ECU may refuse the test. Do not repeat it automatically.

data.name: EvapConfirm
data.value: Request EVAP test conditions once on VIN {0}, physical CAN {1}/{2}?

data.name: EvapExpired
data.value: Authorization expired; test state may be uncertain. Do not repeat automatically.

data.name: EvapNotCompletion
data.value: An acknowledgment does not prove completion or a leak-test result.

data.name: EvapOutcome_UNCERTAIN
data.value: Test request state uncertain — do not repeat automatically.

data.name: EvapOutcome_NOT_TESTED
data.value: Preconditions not verified; no test request sent.

data.name: ClearVinRequired
data.value: Enter the documented 17-character VIN of the vehicle to test.

data.name: ClearWarning
data.value: This reset can erase emissions faults, freeze-frame data and readiness information. Export the original evidence first. Follow the manufacturer's procedure with vehicle stationary and engine stopped. Never use this test to conceal an unresolved fault. No automatic retry.

data.name: ClearConfirm
data.value: Request a single emissions diagnostic reset on VIN {0}, physical CAN {1}/{2}?

data.name: ClearRunning
data.value: Recording pre-reset evidence and checking conditions.

data.name: ClearExpired
data.value: Authorization expired. Reset state may be uncertain; do not repeat automatically.

data.name: ClearNotCompletion
data.value: Permanent DTCs are observed, never assumed erased. An ACK does not prove all ECU faults are absent.

data.name: ClearOutcome_ACKNOWLEDGED_READBACK
data.value: Reset acknowledged; confirmed and pending DTC modes reread.

data.name: ClearOutcome_UNCERTAIN
data.value: Reset state uncertain — do not repeat automatically.

data.name: ClearOutcome_NOT_TESTED
data.value: Conditions not verified; no reset request attempted.

data.name: LegacyConfirmProfile
data.value: I verified the protocol, adapter and ECU response source.

data.name: LegacyScope
data.value: Functional reads, filtered to the selected response source. Not a whole-vehicle scan. No reset or control test.

data.name: LegacyPrerequisites
data.value: Select a J2534 adapter and stop the bridge and console before running the legacy test.

data.name: LegacyDiscoveryScope
data.value: Sources observed during PID 00 discovery; no whole-network coverage or OEM module identity is established.

data.name: LegacyMutationProfile
data.value: I verified the vehicle protocol, engine ECU and all documented emissions response sources.

data.name: LegacyMutationScope
data.value: Functional request to the vehicle: all relevant ECUs, including silent ones, may be affected. A response filter cannot limit this scope.

data.name: LegacyMutationNewFile
data.value: Choose a new output path and a new baseline path.

data.name: LegacyMutationConfirm
data.value: Confirm one vehicle-wide functional request on VIN {0}, {1}, documented sources {2}? Other ECUs may also be affected.

data.name: LegacyMutationUncertain
data.value: Campaign interrupted, unavailable or uncertain. Inspect saved evidence; do not retry automatically.

data.name: NativeUsbPrerequisites
data.value: Stop the bridge, console and other operations first.

data.name: NativeUsbPort
data.value: Select the qualified connector COM port.

data.name: NativeUsbFolder
data.value: Select the private diagnostic report folder.

data.name: NativeUsbConfirm
data.value: Qualified board and documented ECM profile, vehicle stationary. Read-only test on {0}, VIN {1}, CAN {2}/{3}?

data.name: NativeUsbVinMismatch
data.value: VIN unavailable or does not match the selected vehicle.

data.name: NativeUsbProvenance
data.value: Recorded evidence only; physical provenance not established.

data.name: NativeUsbMonitorEncoded
data.value: MID {0:X2} • TID {1:X2} • Scaling {2:X2}: value {3:X4}, min {4:X4}, max {5:X4} (hex)

data.name: NativeUsb_inventory_empty
data.value: No identifiers advertised on this page

data.name: ScanCancelledPartial
data.value: Campaign cancelled. Previously received results only.

data.name: ScanVinInvalid
data.value: Leave VIN blank or enter the documented 17-character VIN.

data.name: NetworkConfirm
data.value: I confirm the documented network and selected physical channels.

data.name: NetworkScope
data.value: Only PID 00 is broadcast. Separate physical scans; no vehicle-wide coverage or mutations.

data.name: LiveConfirm
data.value: I confirm the documented physical ECU and VIN.

data.name: LiveScope
data.value: Separate timestamped read requests; no simultaneous measurements or mutations.

data.name: LiveLegacyConfirm
data.value: Confirm documented legacy variant, response source and VIN. Requests are functional.

data.name: LiveLegacyScope
data.value: Functional requests; selected response filter only. Driver-managed link framing.

data.name: FreezeConfirm
data.value: I have verified the physical ECU channel and selected frame numbers.

data.name: FreezeScope
data.value: Recorded data only; additional OEM frames remain raw. No physical validation.

data.name: FreezeLegacyConfirm
data.value: I confirm these functional requests may reach multiple ECUs; only replies from the selected source are used.

data.name: CatalogueRawReport
data.value: Raw JSON report or CL/1 capture

data.name: CatalogueScope
data.value: Offline byte projection. Transport replay, normative compliance and physical provenance are not verified.

data.name: CatalogueConfirm
data.value: I confirm the VIN and reference digest.

data.name: CatalogueRejected
data.value: Projection rejected. Check the catalogue, reference and recording.

data.name: LiveNativeConfirm
data.value: I confirm the approved physical ECU, VIN, selected PIDs and stationary vehicle.

data.name: LiveNativeVinRequired
data.value: Enter the independently known VIN before inspection.

data.name: LiveNativePrefixScope
data.value: Complete records only; no verified completed recording.

data.name: NativeMaintenanceRecovery
data.value: Recovery required: do not repeat the operation.

data.name: NativeMaintenanceAckEvap
data.value: EVAP preparation acknowledged; no leak-test result

data.name: NativeMaintenanceNoRetry
data.value: No automatic retry or physical proof.

data.name: NativeMaintenanceClearWarning
data.value: Clearing resets diagnostic information and readiness states. Stationary vehicle, engine stopped, ventilated area and qualified board required.

data.name: NativeMaintenanceEvapWarning
data.value: Preparation only, not a leak test. Stationary vehicle, engine stopped, ventilated area and qualified board required.

data.name: NativeMaintenanceAccept
data.value: I acknowledge the consequences and prerequisites

data.name: NativeMaintenanceConfirm
data.value: I confirm one operation with independent local approval on the selected VIN.

data.name: NativeMaintenanceUnverified
data.value: Journal not verified; no successful operation claimed.

data.name: NativeMaintenancePrefixConsistent
data.value: Complete prefix records checked; terminal absent. Recovery remains required.
